_doc: Agent Access monthly call allowance and overage rate (docs/agent-platform-spec.md section 2.5). These are Mary's numbers; nobody else sets them. To change one: edit this file, open a PR, deploy, then run `netlify dev:exec -- node scripts/stripe-setup-agent-overage.js` so the Stripe metered price matches. agent-overage-report refuses to bill while the Stripe price and overage_usd_per_call disagree. confirmed:false turns every quoted number, every alert email and all Stripe reporting off.
basis: Mary's instruction on 2026-09-21 to set the allowance and overage rate. The values are the ones the build had carried as unconfirmed defaults since 2026-09-20 and were reported to her twice before she confirmed. Usage before billing_starts_month is counted on the statement and never billed.
